items.excerpt: Windows 上 Hermes / DeepSeek Harness 无法启动 —— 排障记录 前言： 前些日子一直使用的好好的，更新下了腾讯管家，Hermes / DeepSeek Harness 通通无法启动，本来使用两个工具是可以互相拿来修复，一下全挂了，只能和另一台电脑的hermes通过聊天方式慢慢排查。困扰了两天，真没想到是这个原因。如果有遇到相同问题的兄弟可以借鉴一二。 记录日期：2026-11-17 环境：Windows 10/11 台式机（公司内网），Hermes Agent v0.23.1（git 安装），DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.3 结论： 腾讯电脑管家的网络防护驱动拦截了特定进程的 IPv4 回环连接 ，导致 Python socketpair() 死锁，进而使依赖 asyncio 的客户端全部卡在启动阶段。 一、现象 时间 表现 最初 ping 127.0.0.1 返回"一般故障"，4 发 0 收 同期 DeepSeek Harness 启动报 ETIMEDOUT 127.0.0.1:<随机端口> （8941 / 5907 / 13620 等，每次不同） 同期 Hermes 启动卡住无响应，界面出不来或一直转圈 中间 执行 sfc /scannow 后 ping 127.0.0.1 恢复，但两个客户端仍无法使用 二、排查过程（按…

items.title: Maintainers don’t need more AI bug reports. They need fixes.
items.excerpt: AI has made finding potential vulnerabilities fast and cheap. Fixing them still takes human judgment, and in open source, that work falls to maintainers. Many are already flooded with AI-generated security findings, including duplicates and reports that aren’t vulnerabilities at all. Another raw scan doesn’t help them. Anyone pointing a new model at a project should ask its maintainers first and come with fixes, not just findings. Maintainers are under intense pressure from this flood of reports. items.title: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
items.excerpt: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. items.title: Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache
items.excerpt: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule. We first study how to divide precision between keys and values.
